scripts.text:
[Pet Enthusiast Jenny]
Oh, Hi there!
Are you a lover of animals like I am?
scripts.translation:
[寵物愛好者 珍妮]
哦，你好呀！
你和我一樣喜歡小動物嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pet Enthusiast Jenny]
I know that it's really hard to keep your cute pets happy.
All it takes is the right kind of food.
scripts.translation:
[寵物愛好者 珍妮]
我知道，要讓可愛的寵物保持開心其實挺難的。
只要給它們吃對食物就好了。

scripts.text:
[Pet Enthusiast Jenny]
I know that sometimes it is really hard to get the right food for your pet.
scripts.translation:
[寵物愛好者 珍妮]
我知道，有時候想給寵物找到合適的食物真的很難。

scripts.text:
[Pet Enthusiast Jenny]
Do you have any food that you are looking for?
scripts.translation:
[寵物愛好者 珍妮]
你有想找的食物嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pet Enthusiast Jenny]
Oh, you have ^ff000020 Broken Liquor Jar^000000s and ^ff00001 Alcohol^000000!
Do you want to exchange them for
^ff000020 Spirit Liquor^000000 for your Wanderer pet?
scripts.translation:
[寵物愛好者 珍妮]
哦，你有^ff000020個破碎的酒缸^000000和^ff00001瓶酒精^000000！
要換成^ff000020瓶靈魂酒^000000，餵給你的邪骸浪人寵物嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pet Enthusiast Jenny]
Ok here you go then.
I hope it keeps your
cute pet happy.
scripts.translation:
[寵物愛好者 珍妮]
好的，給你。
希望它能讓你可愛的寵物保持開心。

scripts.text:
[Pet Enthusiast Jenny]
Hehe, well just let me know if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[寵物愛好者 珍妮]
Hehe，改變主意了，隨時告訴我哦。

scripts.text:
[Pet Enthusiast Jenny]
Actually, right now I can help you get Spirit Liquor for Wanderer pets.
scripts.translation:
[寵物愛好者 珍妮]
現在我能幫你弄到邪骸浪人寵物吃的靈魂酒。

scripts.text:
[Pet Enthusiast Jenny]
All you have to do is bring me ^FF0000 20 Broken Liquor Jars^000000 and ^FF0000 1 Alcohol^000000.
I can give you ^FF0000 20 Spirit Liquor^000000 for that.
scripts.translation:
[寵物愛好者 珍妮]
帶來^FF000020個破碎的酒缸^000000和^FF00001瓶酒精^000000，就能換^FF000020瓶靈魂酒^000000。

scripts.text: You can get the Broken Liquor Jars from Tengu monsters in Amatsu dungeon.
scripts.translation: 你可以在櫻花城地下城的天狗怪物身上獲得破碎的酒缸。
